bufferSize.description:
The size of digest buffer. If not set or not positive, a system default value will be used.

The output produced by the digest/sampling process will contain not more than 2*bufferSize points.

upperBiasCount.description:
The number of records (top n and bottom m) to preserve. If not set or < 0, a system default value will be used.

The number of outliers cannot be larger than the buffer size.

valueIndex.description: The position of the value to be indexed in the input. Positions are 0 based. If not set or < 0, the first cell will be used.
